Senior Data Engineer

About us
PulseGrid is a fast-moving analytics startup helping mid-market e-commerce brands compete with enterprise-level data infrastructure. We build high-throughput, cost-conscious data platforms that turn event and transaction streams into timely insights for growth teams. We move quickly, ship pragmatic solutions, and value engineering ownership.

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform and serve petabyte-scale event and transactional data.
- Implement Spark-based batch and streaming jobs to support analytics, ML feature stores and reporting SLA requirements.
- Architect and maintain Snowflake schemas, performance tuning, and cost-optimization strategies.
- Collaborate with product, data science and backend teams to deliver reliable data products and APIs.
- Establish testing, monitoring and observability for data pipelines; respond to incidents and lead postmortems.
- Mentor junior engineers and help shape data platform best practices and roadmaps.

What we need (mandatory)
- 5+ years experience
- Python
- Apache Spark
- Snowflake

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Apache Airflow
- AWS

Location and work mode
Fully remote within India.
